purpose: Retained currentness episodes for accepted Schedule Movement Policy MaterialStates.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Schedule whose Movement Policy currentness is described.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Policy MaterialState selected during this currentness episode.
columns.value_contract: Must belong to the same schedule_ref.

columns.name: current_from_at
columns.meaning: Finite instant when this policy state became current.

columns.name: current_until_at
columns.meaning: Exclusive close instant, null while this policy remains current.
columns.value_contract: Null for the sole open episode; once closed it cannot reopen.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_movement_policy_current_history
primary_key.reason: Identify each currentness episode for one Schedule policy.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_current_history_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Every currentness episode selects an immutable policy state owned by the same Schedule.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_movement_policy_current_history_interval
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(current_from_at) AND (current_until_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(current_until_at) AND current_until_at > current_from_at))
check_constraints.reason: Require finite ordered one-way currentness episodes.

indexes.name: ux_schedule_movement_policy_current_history_open
indexes.reason: At most one open Movement Policy episode per Schedule.

indexes.name: ix_schedule_movement_policy_current_history_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Reverse lookup by immutable policy state.

triggers.name: ctrg_schedule_movement_policy_current_history_equivalence
triggers.reason: Enforce insert-open, close-once, no-overlap and at-most-one-open policy chronology.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Retains accepted policy-current chronology independently from immutable policy payload history.
state_history.current_binding: The sole open episode is the effective Movement Policy for the Schedule; retirement leaves no open episode.
state_history.immutability_policy: Episode identity and selected state are immutable; only one-way close is permitted.

lifecycle.retention: Retain across revise and retire for reconstructible governance history.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime delete; retire closes the open episode.

obligations: one non-overlapping open policy episode at most
revision closes old and opens new
